experiment.name: 3way_rag_comparison
experiment.description: Comprehensive comparison of Naive RAG vs KG RAG Simple vs KG RAG Cypher Generation

questions.description: Using 50 questions from golden dataset (balanced single-hop + multi-hop, all Korean)

models.description: All 5 models: GPT-4o-mini, EXAONE3.5-7.8B, Qwen3-8B, Gemma3-12B, GPT-OSS-20B

retrieval.name: naive_rag
retrieval.description: Naive RAG with FAISS vectorstore (5,879 chunks, 3072D embeddings)

retrieval.name: kg_simple
retrieval.description: KG RAG Simple: Fixed Cypher with vector similarity (6,544 nodes, 9,554 relationships)

retrieval.name: kg_cypher_generation
retrieval.description: KG RAG Cypher Generation: LLM-generated Cypher for dynamic graph traversal

evaluation.description: RAGAS evaluation with GPT-4o-mini as judge

notes: Total evaluations: 3 modes × 6 models × 50 questions = 900 evaluations
Expected runtime: ~2-3 hours (depends on Ollama model speed)
Cost estimate: ~$5-10 for GPT-4o-mini judge + OpenAI embeddings
Known limitation: KG modes may have reduced recall for date-specific queries (see docs/kg_data_limitations.md)
